scope: Independent read-only methodological review and deterministic checks of saved-document/configuration values; no new physics, model inference, training, or snapshot restoration.
resolved_review_findings: Separate A first-hit, full-H5 physical validity and ready eligibility; account for post-ready invalidity versus B absorbing termination.
Specify nonlatched B zero supervisor and separate nonterminal hold tracker after official ready.
Do not infer missing base-bank capability from unstable or missing actual candidates.
Include restoration, pilot, teacher-forcing and extension in total resource gate; reuse only exact accepted artifacts.
Compute numerical epsilon only from finite actual-valid costs; no actual-valid candidates produces null and NO_VALID_ACTUAL.
remaining_limits: Six posthoc states come from five initial families and all source trajectories are S1; no symmetric model-policy population or success-rate inference.
A is a fixed-command open-loop assay and B is a committed candidate plus supervisor/zero suffix, neither reproduces full MPC replanning.
Actual futures are diagnostic oracle labels and must not feed frozen online selection.
Model/cost/interface/search evidence is local and nonexclusive; it does not identify a sole cause of original E2 failure.
The real restoration, raw round-trip, memory/storage/time gate and physical repeat fidelity remain untested.
Exact arbitrary-tick internal state cannot be compared against an unavailable original full snapshot; provenance must state available comparison scope.
Finite-bank expansion cannot establish global reachability or unreachability.
